test_run_dqn_agent: test the DQN agent by running 200 episodes using RunDQNTest.test_run
run_dqn_main: run the DQN agent main function with run_dqn.main(None) for training
test_RunnDQNTest_class: test the RunDQNTest class that validates the simple DQN agent execution
run_absltest_main: run the absltest.main() entry point to execute all DQN agent tests
set_num_episodes_flag: set FLAGS.num_episodes to configure the number of training episodes for the DQN agent
